task: Win the fight: defeat the goblins at the windmill.
scored_by: Passed the first moment a fight is won (a combat that ends with the enemies beaten and the party standing; the one ahead of you is the fight). Nothing else counts toward the score: party members downed or killed, game time and cost are reported next to it.
about: Fight (family 1), an Act 1 ambush: the goblins and worgs tormenting the gnome at the Blighted Village windmill, nine enemies with archers on high ground. claude-run-2 S014 won it in 7 rounds with one down (111 party HP lost).

note.where: The Blighted Village, east of the windmill; goblins and worgs ahead, out of combat.
note.objective: Defeat the goblins at the windmill.
